source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the identification, absolute wording’s ordinary force, and Judas’s position.
key_decisions.before: They answered, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He said, “I am.” Judas, the one handing him over, was standing with them.
key_decisions.after: They answered him, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He told them, “I am he.” Judas, who was betraying him, was standing with them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the repeated declaration and physical reaction.
key_decisions.before: When Jesus said, “I am,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
key_decisions.after: When Jesus told them, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When Jesus said to them, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all arresting parties, seizure, and binding while identifying the officers’ leadership context.
key_decisions.before: Then the cohort, its commander, and the Jewish officers arrested Jesus and bound him.
key_decisions.after: Then the cohort, its commander, and the Judean leaders’ officers arrested Jesus and bound him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So the soldiers, their officer, and the Judean officers arrested Jesus and bound him.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps public speech, teaching locations, Jewish setting, and denial of secret doctrine.
key_decisions.before: Jesus answered, “I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all Jewish people gather. I said nothing in secret.
key_decisions.after: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in a synagogue and in the temple courts, where all the Jewish people gather. I said nothing in secret.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all the Judeans gather, and I have said nothing in secret.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps real physical abuse, officer, and accusatory question.
key_decisions.before: When Jesus said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped him and said, “Is that how you answer the high priest?”
key_decisions.after: When Jesus said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped him and said, “Is that how you answer the high priest?”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, “Is that how you answer the high priest?”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps movement, time, Gentile headquarters, purity concern, and Passover purpose.
key_decisions.before: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor’s headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not enter the headquarters so they would not become defiled but could eat the Passover.
key_decisions.after: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor’s headquarters. It was early morning. They did not enter the headquarters themselves, so that they would not become ceremonially unclean but could eat the Passover meal.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor’s headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not enter the headquarters, so that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Pilate’s directive, their law, and stated restriction.
key_decisions.before: Pilate said, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your Law.” The Jewish leaders said, “It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death.”
key_decisions.after: Pilate told them, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your law.” The Judean leaders replied, “We are not permitted to put anyone to death.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your law.” The Judeans said to him, “It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves origin rather than location of kingdom, counterfactual fighting, handover, and repetition.
key_decisions.before: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not from this world. If my kingdom were from this world, my servants would fight so that I would not be handed over to the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is not from here.”
key_decisions.after: Jesus answered, “My kingdom does not come from this world. If my kingdom came from this world, my servants would be fighting to keep me from being handed over to the Judean leaders. But as it is, my kingdom does not come from here.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not from this world. If my kingdom were from this world, my servants would be fighting so that I might not be handed over to the Judeans. But as it is, my kingdom is not from here.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps disputed royal formulation, birth, coming, witness, truth, belonging, and voice.
key_decisions.before: Pilate said, “So you are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this I came into the world: to testify to the truth. Everyone who is from the truth listens to my voice.”
key_decisions.after: Pilate asked him, “So you are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this I came into the world: to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to my voice.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then Pilate said to him, “So you are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this I have come into the world: to bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves crowd choice and renders the term’s range beyond a mere private thief.
key_decisions.before: They shouted back, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
key_decisions.after: They shouted again, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a violent rebel.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They cried out again, “Not this one, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a bandit.
